meta.ci_notes: Across-seed CIs: t-interval on per-seed values. Primary-split CIs: bootstrap resampling unique payloads within each class (B per primary_bootstrap_B).
meta.eval_set: val/test: up to 1500 unique benign per domain x1 wrapper; every unique attack payload x3 random wrappers; PR-AUC depends on this attack prevalence.
caveats: Models are re-trained with the production recipe; shipped fed_model.json is not scored (its training payloads overlap random test splits). Threshold 0.15 was set for the shipped model, so FPR at 0.15 here characterises the recipe.
Benign data are SecLists word lists, not real traffic.
Gateway scorer re-implements continuous_waf._inspect_request; request construction (location mix, background headers) is synthetic.
Benign near-duplicate grouping is a normalised key, not edit distance.
